texts:
# Lakeview Horizon Suites

## Hotel Overview
Lakeview Horizon Suites is located in Chicago, IL, USA. Spacious suites in the Loop district

**Guest Rating:** 4.4/5.0
**Total Rooms:** 220

## Contact Information
**Address:** 987 State Street, Chicago, IL 60605
**Phone:** +1-312-555-0006
**Email:** chicagosuites@anycompany.com

## Check-in & Check-out

### Check-in Time
Standard check-in time is 3:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to availability and may be requested at the time of booking or by contacting the hotel directly.

### Check-out Time
Standard check-out time is 11:00 AM. Late check-out until 2:00 PM may be available for an additional fee of $50, subject to availability.

### Express Check-out
Express check-out is available. Guests can review and approve their bill the night before departure and simply drop off their room keys at the front desk or in the express check-out box.

## Reservations & Cancellations

### Making a Reservation
Reservations can be made through:
- Our website: www.anycompany.com
- Phone: +1-312-555-0006
- Email: chicagosuites@anycompany.com
- Mobile app: AnyCompany Hotels

### Cancellation Policy
Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours prior to arrival to avoid a one-night room charge. Cancellations for group bookings (10+ rooms) require 72 hours notice.

### Modification Policy
Reservations can be modified up to 24 hours before arrival at no charge. Changes to dates are subject to availability and rate differences may apply.

### Deposit Requirements
A valid credit card is required at the time of booking. A deposit equal to one night's room rate plus tax will be charged at booking for reservations made within 7 days of arrival.

### Payment Methods
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and Diners Club. Cash and debit cards are also accepted.

## Room Information

### Room Types Available
- **Standard Room:** Comfortable accommodations with essential amenities ($200-350 per night)
- **Deluxe Room:** Enhanced space and upgraded amenities ($350-500 per night)
- **Suite:** Spacious suite with separate living area ($550-900 per night)

### Bed Configurations
- King bed
- Two Queen beds
- Accessible rooms with King bed

### Maximum Occupancy
- Standard/Deluxe Rooms: Up to 4 guests
- Suites: Up to 6 guests

### In-Room Amenities
All rooms include:
- Complimentary high-speed WiFi
- Flat-screen TV with premium channels
- Coffee maker with complimentary coffee and tea
- Mini-refrigerator
- In-room safe
- Iron and ironing board
- Hair dryer
- Complimentary toiletries
- Climate control

### Accessibility Features
Accessible rooms are available featuring:
- Roll-in showers or accessible tubs
- Grab bars
- Lowered fixtures
- Visual alert systems
- Accessible door hardware

## Hotel Amenities

- Outdoor Swimming Pool
- 24-Hour Fitness Center
- Complimentary High-Speed Wifi
- On-Site Restaurant
- Full-Service Spa

### Pool
Our outdoor pool is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Pool towels are provided.

### Fitness Center
Our 24-hour fitness center is equipped with cardio machines, free weights, and strength training equipment.

### Restaurant & Bar
Our on-site restaurant serves breakfast (6:30 AM - 10:30 AM), lunch (11:30 AM - 2:30 PM), and dinner (5:30 PM - 10:00 PM). The bar is open from 4:00 PM to midnight.

### Business Center
Business center facilities are not available at this property.

### Parking
Parking is available for $15 per night. Self-parking is available in our parking facility.

### Pet Policy
Pets are welcome! We charge a non-refundable pet fee of $50 per stay. Maximum of 2 pets per room, with a weight limit of 50 lbs per pet. Service animals are always welcome at no charge.

## Pricing & Fees

### Room Rates
Room rates vary by season and availability:
- Standard Room: $200-350 per night
- Deluxe Room: $350-500 per night
- Suite: $550-900 per night

Rates are subject to change and do not include taxes and fees.

### Resort Fees
A resort fee of $35 per night per night applies and includes WiFi, fitness center access, and pool access.

### Parking Fees
$15 per night

### Pet Fees
$50 per stay (non-refundable)

### Extra Guest Charges
Additional guests beyond standard occupancy: $25 per person per night (children under 12 stay free)

## Location & Transportation

### Address & Directions
987 State Street, Chicago, IL 60605

### Airport Transportation
Airport shuttle service is not provided. Taxi and rideshare services are readily available.

### Public Transportation
The hotel is conveniently located near public transportation options. Please contact the front desk for detailed directions and schedules.

### Nearby Attractions
Spacious suites in the Loop district Our concierge can provide recommendations and assistance with booking local tours and attractions.

## Services

### Room Service
Room service is not available. However, many delivery options are available in the area.

### Housekeeping
Daily housekeeping service is provided. Additional cleaning services can be requested at the front desk.

### Laundry Services
Laundry services can be arranged through the front desk with local providers.

### Concierge Services
Front desk staff are happy to provide local recommendations and assistance.

### Wake-up Calls
Automated wake-up calls can be arranged through your in-room phone or by contacting the front desk.

## Policies

### Smoking Policy
Lakeview Horizon Suites is a non-smoking property. Smoking is permitted in designated outdoor areas only. A cleaning fee of $250 applies to any smoking in guest rooms.

### Age Requirements
Guests must be at least 18 years of age to check in.

### ID Requirements
A valid government-issued photo ID and credit card are required at check-in.

### Damage Policy
Guests are responsible for any damage to hotel property. Charges for damages will be applied to the credit card on file.

### Quiet Hours
Quiet hours are observed from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. We ask all guests to be respectful of others during these hours.

## WiFi & Technology

### WiFi Availability
Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms and public areas.

### Network Access
Network name and password are provided at check-in and are also available in your guest room.

### Smart TV
All rooms feature smart TVs with access to premium channels and streaming capabilities.

### Charging Ports
Rooms are equipped with USB charging ports and standard electrical outlets.

## Special Requests

### Cribs & Rollaway Beds
Cribs are available at no charge (subject to availability). Rollaway beds are available for $25 per night.

### Connecting Rooms
Connecting rooms are available and can be requested at the time of booking (subject to availability).

### Floor Preferences
High floor and low floor preferences can be requested but cannot be guaranteed. We will do our best to accommodate your preference.

### Hypoallergenic Rooms
Hypoallergenic rooms with special cleaning protocols are available upon request. Please notify us at the time of booking.

## Additional Information

For any questions or special requests, please contact us at:
- Phone: +1-312-555-0006
- Email: chicagosuites@anycompany.com

We look forward to welcoming you to Lakeview Horizon Suites!

## Chicago Hotels with BOTH Spa and Pool:

### **Lakeview Horizon Suites** ✅
- **Location:** 987 State Street, Chicago, IL 60605 (Loop district)
- **Guest Rating:** 4.4/5.0
- **Amenities:** Outdoor Swimming Pool + Full-Service Spa
- Pool hours: 6:00 AM - 10:00 PM daily, pool towels provided
- Also includes: 24-hour fitness center, on-site restaurant, complimentary WiFi
- Room rates: $200-900/night depending on room type
- Resort fee: $35/night (includes WiFi, fitness, and pool access)

## Other Chicago Hotel Checked (Does NOT Match):

**Windward Mile Tower** ❌
- Located at 654 Michigan Avenue, Chicago, IL 60611
- Has a business center and fitness center, but **no pool facilities** and no spa mentioned
- Known for its Lake Michigan views instead

---

**Summary:** Of the Chicago properties in our system, **Lakeview Horizon Suites** is the hotel that offers both a full-service spa and an outdoor swimming pool. If you'd like, I can check for additional Chicago properties or provide more details on booking, pricing, or specific room types at Lakeview Horizon Suites!

# Lakeview Horizon Suites

## Hotel Overview
Lakeview Horizon Suites is located in Chicago, IL, USA. Spacious suites in the Loop district

**Guest Rating:** 4.4/5.0
**Total Rooms:** 220

## Contact Information
**Address:** 987 State Street, Chicago, IL 60605
**Phone:** +1-312-555-0006
**Email:** chicagosuites@anycompany.com

## Check-in & Check-out

### Check-in Time
Standard check-in time is 3:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to availability and may be requested at the time of booking or by contacting the hotel directly.

### Check-out Time
Standard check-out time is 11:00 AM. Late check-out until 2:00 PM may be available for an additional fee of $50, subject to availability.

### Express Check-out
Express check-out is available. Guests can review and approve their bill the night before departure and simply drop off their room keys at the front desk or in the express check-out box.

## Reservations & Cancellations

### Making a Reservation
Reservations can be made through:
- Our website: www.anycompany.com
- Phone: +1-312-555-0006
- Email: chicagosuites@anycompany.com
- Mobile app: AnyCompany Hotels

### Cancellation Policy
Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours prior to arrival to avoid a one-night room charge. Cancellations for group bookings (10+ rooms) require 72 hours notice.

### Modification Policy
Reservations can be modified up to 24 hours before arrival at no charge. Changes to dates are subject to availability and rate differences may apply.

### Deposit Requirements
A valid credit card is required at the time of booking. A deposit equal to one night's room rate plus tax will be charged at booking for reservations made within 7 days of arrival.

### Payment Methods
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and Diners Club. Cash and debit cards are also accepted.

## Room Information

### Room Types Available
- **Standard Room:** Comfortable accommodations with essential amenities ($200-350 per night)
- **Deluxe Room:** Enhanced space and upgraded amenities ($350-500 per night)
- **Suite:** Spacious suite with separate living area ($550-900 per night)

### Bed Configurations
- King bed
- Two Queen beds
- Accessible rooms with King bed

### Maximum Occupancy
- Standard/Deluxe Rooms: Up to 4 guests
- Suites: Up to 6 guests

### In-Room Amenities
All rooms include:
- Complimentary high-speed WiFi
- Flat-screen TV with premium channels
- Coffee maker with complimentary coffee and tea
- Mini-refrigerator
- In-room safe
- Iron and ironing board
- Hair dryer
- Complimentary toiletries
- Climate control

### Accessibility Features
Accessible rooms are available featuring:
- Roll-in showers or accessible tubs
- Grab bars
- Lowered fixtures
- Visual alert systems
- Accessible door hardware

## Hotel Amenities

- Outdoor Swimming Pool
- 24-Hour Fitness Center
- Complimentary High-Speed Wifi
- On-Site Restaurant
- Full-Service Spa

### Pool
Our outdoor pool is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Pool towels are provided.

### Fitness Center
Our 24-hour fitness center is equipped with cardio machines, free weights, and strength training equipment.

### Restaurant & Bar
Our on-site restaurant serves breakfast (6:30 AM - 10:30 AM), lunch (11:30 AM - 2:30 PM), and dinner (5:30 PM - 10:00 PM). The bar is open from 4:00 PM to midnight.

### Business Center
Business center facilities are not available at this property.

### Parking
Parking is available for $15 per night. Self-parking is available in our parking facility.

### Pet Policy
Pets are welcome! We charge a non-refundable pet fee of $50 per stay. Maximum of 2 pets per room, with a weight limit of 50 lbs per pet. Service animals are always welcome at no charge.

## Pricing & Fees

### Room Rates
Room rates vary by season and availability:
- Standard Room: $200-350 per night
- Deluxe Room: $350-500 per night
- Suite: $550-900 per night

Rates are subject to change and do not include taxes and fees.

### Resort Fees
A resort fee of $35 per night per night applies and includes WiFi, fitness center access, and pool access.

### Parking Fees
$15 per night

### Pet Fees
$50 per stay (non-refundable)

### Extra Guest Charges
Additional guests beyond standard occupancy: $25 per person per night (children under 12 stay free)

## Location & Transportation

### Address & Directions
987 State Street, Chicago, IL 60605

### Airport Transportation
Airport shuttle service is not provided. Taxi and rideshare services are readily available.

### Public Transportation
The hotel is conveniently located near public transportation options. Please contact the front desk for detailed directions and schedules.

### Nearby Attractions
Spacious suites in the Loop district Our concierge can provide recommendations and assistance with booking local tours and attractions.

## Services

### Room Service
Room service is not available. However, many delivery options are available in the area.

### Housekeeping
Daily housekeeping service is provided. Additional cleaning services can be requested at the front desk.

### Laundry Services
Laundry services can be arranged through the front desk with local providers.

### Concierge Services
Front desk staff are happy to provide local recommendations and assistance.

### Wake-up Calls
Automated wake-up calls can be arranged through your in-room phone or by contacting the front desk.

## Policies

### Smoking Policy
Lakeview Horizon Suites is a non-smoking property. Smoking is permitted in designated outdoor areas only. A cleaning fee of $250 applies to any smoking in guest rooms.

### Age Requirements
Guests must be at least 18 years of age to check in.

### ID Requirements
A valid government-issued photo ID and credit card are required at check-in.

### Damage Policy
Guests are responsible for any damage to hotel property. Charges for damages will be applied to the credit card on file.

### Quiet Hours
Quiet hours are observed from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. We ask all guests to be respectful of others during these hours.

## WiFi & Technology

### WiFi Availability
Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms and public areas.

### Network Access
Network name and password are provided at check-in and are also available in your guest room.

### Smart TV
All rooms feature smart TVs with access to premium channels and streaming capabilities.

### Charging Ports
Rooms are equipped with USB charging ports and standard electrical outlets.

## Special Requests

### Cribs & Rollaway Beds
Cribs are available at no charge (subject to availability). Rollaway beds are available for $25 per night.

### Connecting Rooms
Connecting rooms are available and can be requested at the time of booking (subject to availability).

### Floor Preferences
High floor and low floor preferences can be requested but cannot be guaranteed. We will do our best to accommodate your preference.

### Hypoallergenic Rooms
Hypoallergenic rooms with special cleaning protocols are available upon request. Please notify us at the time of booking.

## Additional Information

For any questions or special requests, please contact us at:
- Phone: +1-312-555-0006
- Email: chicagosuites@anycompany.com

We look forward to welcoming you to Lakeview Horizon Suites!

texts:
# Lakeview Horizon Suites

## Hotel Overview
Lakeview Horizon Suites is located in Chicago, IL, USA. Spacious suites in the Loop district

**Guest Rating:** 4.4/5.0
**Total Rooms:** 220

## Contact Information
**Address:** 987 State Street, Chicago, IL 60605
**Phone:** +1-312-555-0006
**Email:** chicagosuites@anycompany.com

## Check-in & Check-out

### Check-in Time
Standard check-in time is 3:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to availability and may be requested at the time of booking or by contacting the hotel directly.

### Check-out Time
Standard check-out time is 11:00 AM. Late check-out until 2:00 PM may be available for an additional fee of $50, subject to availability.

### Express Check-out
Express check-out is available. Guests can review and approve their bill the night before departure and simply drop off their room keys at the front desk or in the express check-out box.

## Reservations & Cancellations

### Making a Reservation
Reservations can be made through:
- Our website: www.anycompany.com
- Phone: +1-312-555-0006
- Email: chicagosuites@anycompany.com
- Mobile app: AnyCompany Hotels

### Cancellation Policy
Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours prior to arrival to avoid a one-night room charge. Cancellations for group bookings (10+ rooms) require 72 hours notice.

### Modification Policy
Reservations can be modified up to 24 hours before arrival at no charge. Changes to dates are subject to availability and rate differences may apply.

### Deposit Requirements
A valid credit card is required at the time of booking. A deposit equal to one night's room rate plus tax will be charged at booking for reservations made within 7 days of arrival.

### Payment Methods
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and Diners Club. Cash and debit cards are also accepted.

## Room Information

### Room Types Available
- **Standard Room:** Comfortable accommodations with essential amenities ($200-350 per night)
- **Deluxe Room:** Enhanced space and upgraded amenities ($350-500 per night)
- **Suite:** Spacious suite with separate living area ($550-900 per night)

### Bed Configurations
- King bed
- Two Queen beds
- Accessible rooms with King bed

### Maximum Occupancy
- Standard/Deluxe Rooms: Up to 4 guests
- Suites: Up to 6 guests

### In-Room Amenities
All rooms include:
- Complimentary high-speed WiFi
- Flat-screen TV with premium channels
- Coffee maker with complimentary coffee and tea
- Mini-refrigerator
- In-room safe
- Iron and ironing board
- Hair dryer
- Complimentary toiletries
- Climate control

### Accessibility Features
Accessible rooms are available featuring:
- Roll-in showers or accessible tubs
- Grab bars
- Lowered fixtures
- Visual alert systems
- Accessible door hardware

## Hotel Amenities

- Outdoor Swimming Pool
- 24-Hour Fitness Center
- Complimentary High-Speed Wifi
- On-Site Restaurant
- Full-Service Spa

### Pool
Our outdoor pool is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Pool towels are provided.

### Fitness Center
Our 24-hour fitness center is equipped with cardio machines, free weights, and strength training equipment.

### Restaurant & Bar
Our on-site restaurant serves breakfast (6:30 AM - 10:30 AM), lunch (11:30 AM - 2:30 PM), and dinner (5:30 PM - 10:00 PM). The bar is open from 4:00 PM to midnight.

### Business Center
Business center facilities are not available at this property.

### Parking
Parking is available for $15 per night. Self-parking is available in our parking facility.

### Pet Policy
Pets are welcome! We charge a non-refundable pet fee of $50 per stay. Maximum of 2 pets per room, with a weight limit of 50 lbs per pet. Service animals are always welcome at no charge.

## Pricing & Fees

### Room Rates
Room rates vary by season and availability:
- Standard Room: $200-350 per night
- Deluxe Room: $350-500 per night
- Suite: $550-900 per night

Rates are subject to change and do not include taxes and fees.

### Resort Fees
A resort fee of $35 per night per night applies and includes WiFi, fitness center access, and pool access.

### Parking Fees
$15 per night

### Pet Fees
$50 per stay (non-refundable)

### Extra Guest Charges
Additional guests beyond standard occupancy: $25 per person per night (children under 12 stay free)

## Location & Transportation

### Address & Directions
987 State Street, Chicago, IL 60605

### Airport Transportation
Airport shuttle service is not provided. Taxi and rideshare services are readily available.

### Public Transportation
The hotel is conveniently located near public transportation options. Please contact the front desk for detailed directions and schedules.

### Nearby Attractions
Spacious suites in the Loop district Our concierge can provide recommendations and assistance with booking local tours and attractions.

## Services

### Room Service
Room service is not available. However, many delivery options are available in the area.

### Housekeeping
Daily housekeeping service is provided. Additional cleaning services can be requested at the front desk.

### Laundry Services
Laundry services can be arranged through the front desk with local providers.

### Concierge Services
Front desk staff are happy to provide local recommendations and assistance.

### Wake-up Calls
Automated wake-up calls can be arranged through your in-room phone or by contacting the front desk.

## Policies

### Smoking Policy
Lakeview Horizon Suites is a non-smoking property. Smoking is permitted in designated outdoor areas only. A cleaning fee of $250 applies to any smoking in guest rooms.

### Age Requirements
Guests must be at least 18 years of age to check in.

### ID Requirements
A valid government-issued photo ID and credit card are required at check-in.

### Damage Policy
Guests are responsible for any damage to hotel property. Charges for damages will be applied to the credit card on file.

### Quiet Hours
Quiet hours are observed from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. We ask all guests to be respectful of others during these hours.

## WiFi & Technology

### WiFi Availability
Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms and public areas.

### Network Access
Network name and password are provided at check-in and are also available in your guest room.

### Smart TV
All rooms feature smart TVs with access to premium channels and streaming capabilities.

### Charging Ports
Rooms are equipped with USB charging ports and standard electrical outlets.

## Special Requests

### Cribs & Rollaway Beds
Cribs are available at no charge (subject to availability). Rollaway beds are available for $25 per night.

### Connecting Rooms
Connecting rooms are available and can be requested at the time of booking (subject to availability).

### Floor Preferences
High floor and low floor preferences can be requested but cannot be guaranteed. We will do our best to accommodate your preference.

### Hypoallergenic Rooms
Hypoallergenic rooms with special cleaning protocols are available upon request. Please notify us at the time of booking.

## Additional Information

For any questions or special requests, please contact us at:
- Phone: +1-312-555-0006
- Email: chicagosuites@anycompany.com

We look forward to welcoming you to Lakeview Horizon Suites!

# Lakeview Horizon Suites

## Hotel Overview
Lakeview Horizon Suites is located in Chicago, IL, USA. Spacious suites in the Loop district

**Guest Rating:** 4.4/5.0
**Total Rooms:** 220

## Contact Information
**Address:** 987 State Street, Chicago, IL 60605
**Phone:** +1-312-555-0006
**Email:** chicagosuites@anycompany.com

## Check-in & Check-out

### Check-in Time
Standard check-in time is 3:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to availability and may be requested at the time of booking or by contacting the hotel directly.

### Check-out Time
Standard check-out time is 11:00 AM. Late check-out until 2:00 PM may be available for an additional fee of $50, subject to availability.

### Express Check-out
Express check-out is available. Guests can review and approve their bill the night before departure and simply drop off their room keys at the front desk or in the express check-out box.

## Reservations & Cancellations

### Making a Reservation
Reservations can be made through:
- Our website: www.anycompany.com
- Phone: +1-312-555-0006
- Email: chicagosuites@anycompany.com
- Mobile app: AnyCompany Hotels

### Cancellation Policy
Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours prior to arrival to avoid a one-night room charge. Cancellations for group bookings (10+ rooms) require 72 hours notice.

### Modification Policy
Reservations can be modified up to 24 hours before arrival at no charge. Changes to dates are subject to availability and rate differences may apply.

### Deposit Requirements
A valid credit card is required at the time of booking. A deposit equal to one night's room rate plus tax will be charged at booking for reservations made within 7 days of arrival.

### Payment Methods
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and Diners Club. Cash and debit cards are also accepted.

## Room Information

### Room Types Available
- **Standard Room:** Comfortable accommodations with essential amenities ($200-350 per night)
- **Deluxe Room:** Enhanced space and upgraded amenities ($350-500 per night)
- **Suite:** Spacious suite with separate living area ($550-900 per night)

### Bed Configurations
- King bed
- Two Queen beds
- Accessible rooms with King bed

### Maximum Occupancy
- Standard/Deluxe Rooms: Up to 4 guests
- Suites: Up to 6 guests

### In-Room Amenities
All rooms include:
- Complimentary high-speed WiFi
- Flat-screen TV with premium channels
- Coffee maker with complimentary coffee and tea
- Mini-refrigerator
- In-room safe
- Iron and ironing board
- Hair dryer
- Complimentary toiletries
- Climate control

### Accessibility Features
Accessible rooms are available featuring:
- Roll-in showers or accessible tubs
- Grab bars
- Lowered fixtures
- Visual alert systems
- Accessible door hardware

## Hotel Amenities

- Outdoor Swimming Pool
- 24-Hour Fitness Center
- Complimentary High-Speed Wifi
- On-Site Restaurant
- Full-Service Spa

### Pool
Our outdoor pool is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Pool towels are provided.

### Fitness Center
Our 24-hour fitness center is equipped with cardio machines, free weights, and strength training equipment.

### Restaurant & Bar
Our on-site restaurant serves breakfast (6:30 AM - 10:30 AM), lunch (11:30 AM - 2:30 PM), and dinner (5:30 PM - 10:00 PM). The bar is open from 4:00 PM to midnight.

### Business Center
Business center facilities are not available at this property.

### Parking
Parking is available for $15 per night. Self-parking is available in our parking facility.

### Pet Policy
Pets are welcome! We charge a non-refundable pet fee of $50 per stay. Maximum of 2 pets per room, with a weight limit of 50 lbs per pet. Service animals are always welcome at no charge.

## Pricing & Fees

### Room Rates
Room rates vary by season and availability:
- Standard Room: $200-350 per night
- Deluxe Room: $350-500 per night
- Suite: $550-900 per night

Rates are subject to change and do not include taxes and fees.

### Resort Fees
A resort fee of $35 per night per night applies and includes WiFi, fitness center access, and pool access.

### Parking Fees
$15 per night

### Pet Fees
$50 per stay (non-refundable)

### Extra Guest Charges
Additional guests beyond standard occupancy: $25 per person per night (children under 12 stay free)

## Location & Transportation

### Address & Directions
987 State Street, Chicago, IL 60605

### Airport Transportation
Airport shuttle service is not provided. Taxi and rideshare services are readily available.

### Public Transportation
The hotel is conveniently located near public transportation options. Please contact the front desk for detailed directions and schedules.

### Nearby Attractions
Spacious suites in the Loop district Our concierge can provide recommendations and assistance with booking local tours and attractions.

## Services

### Room Service
Room service is not available. However, many delivery options are available in the area.

### Housekeeping
Daily housekeeping service is provided. Additional cleaning services can be requested at the front desk.

### Laundry Services
Laundry services can be arranged through the front desk with local providers.

### Concierge Services
Front desk staff are happy to provide local recommendations and assistance.

### Wake-up Calls
Automated wake-up calls can be arranged through your in-room phone or by contacting the front desk.

## Policies

### Smoking Policy
Lakeview Horizon Suites is a non-smoking property. Smoking is permitted in designated outdoor areas only. A cleaning fee of $250 applies to any smoking in guest rooms.

### Age Requirements
Guests must be at least 18 years of age to check in.

### ID Requirements
A valid government-issued photo ID and credit card are required at check-in.

### Damage Policy
Guests are responsible for any damage to hotel property. Charges for damages will be applied to the credit card on file.

### Quiet Hours
Quiet hours are observed from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. We ask all guests to be respectful of others during these hours.

## WiFi & Technology

### WiFi Availability
Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms and public areas.

### Network Access
Network name and password are provided at check-in and are also available in your guest room.

### Smart TV
All rooms feature smart TVs with access to premium channels and streaming capabilities.

### Charging Ports
Rooms are equipped with USB charging ports and standard electrical outlets.

## Special Requests

### Cribs & Rollaway Beds
Cribs are available at no charge (subject to availability). Rollaway beds are available for $25 per night.

### Connecting Rooms
Connecting rooms are available and can be requested at the time of booking (subject to availability).

### Floor Preferences
High floor and low floor preferences can be requested but cannot be guaranteed. We will do our best to accommodate your preference.

### Hypoallergenic Rooms
Hypoallergenic rooms with special cleaning protocols are available upon request. Please notify us at the time of booking.

## Additional Information

For any questions or special requests, please contact us at:
- Phone: +1-312-555-0006
- Email: chicagosuites@anycompany.com

We look forward to welcoming you to Lakeview Horizon Suites!

texts:
# Lakeview Horizon Suites

## Hotel Overview
Lakeview Horizon Suites is located in Chicago, IL, USA. Spacious suites in the Loop district

**Guest Rating:** 4.4/5.0
**Total Rooms:** 220

## Contact Information
**Address:** 987 State Street, Chicago, IL 60605
**Phone:** +1-312-555-0006
**Email:** chicagosuites@anycompany.com

## Check-in & Check-out

### Check-in Time
Standard check-in time is 3:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to availability and may be requested at the time of booking or by contacting the hotel directly.

### Check-out Time
Standard check-out time is 11:00 AM. Late check-out until 2:00 PM may be available for an additional fee of $50, subject to availability.

### Express Check-out
Express check-out is available. Guests can review and approve their bill the night before departure and simply drop off their room keys at the front desk or in the express check-out box.

## Reservations & Cancellations

### Making a Reservation
Reservations can be made through:
- Our website: www.anycompany.com
- Phone: +1-312-555-0006
- Email: chicagosuites@anycompany.com
- Mobile app: AnyCompany Hotels

### Cancellation Policy
Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours prior to arrival to avoid a one-night room charge. Cancellations for group bookings (10+ rooms) require 72 hours notice.

### Modification Policy
Reservations can be modified up to 24 hours before arrival at no charge. Changes to dates are subject to availability and rate differences may apply.

### Deposit Requirements
A valid credit card is required at the time of booking. A deposit equal to one night's room rate plus tax will be charged at booking for reservations made within 7 days of arrival.

### Payment Methods
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and Diners Club. Cash and debit cards are also accepted.

## Room Information

### Room Types Available
- **Standard Room:** Comfortable accommodations with essential amenities ($200-350 per night)
- **Deluxe Room:** Enhanced space and upgraded amenities ($350-500 per night)
- **Suite:** Spacious suite with separate living area ($550-900 per night)

### Bed Configurations
- King bed
- Two Queen beds
- Accessible rooms with King bed

### Maximum Occupancy
- Standard/Deluxe Rooms: Up to 4 guests
- Suites: Up to 6 guests

### In-Room Amenities
All rooms include:
- Complimentary high-speed WiFi
- Flat-screen TV with premium channels
- Coffee maker with complimentary coffee and tea
- Mini-refrigerator
- In-room safe
- Iron and ironing board
- Hair dryer
- Complimentary toiletries
- Climate control

### Accessibility Features
Accessible rooms are available featuring:
- Roll-in showers or accessible tubs
- Grab bars
- Lowered fixtures
- Visual alert systems
- Accessible door hardware

## Hotel Amenities

- Outdoor Swimming Pool
- 24-Hour Fitness Center
- Complimentary High-Speed Wifi
- On-Site Restaurant
- Full-Service Spa

### Pool
Our outdoor pool is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Pool towels are provided.

### Fitness Center
Our 24-hour fitness center is equipped with cardio machines, free weights, and strength training equipment.

### Restaurant & Bar
Our on-site restaurant serves breakfast (6:30 AM - 10:30 AM), lunch (11:30 AM - 2:30 PM), and dinner (5:30 PM - 10:00 PM). The bar is open from 4:00 PM to midnight.

### Business Center
Business center facilities are not available at this property.

### Parking
Parking is available for $15 per night. Self-parking is available in our parking facility.

### Pet Policy
Pets are welcome! We charge a non-refundable pet fee of $50 per stay. Maximum of 2 pets per room, with a weight limit of 50 lbs per pet. Service animals are always welcome at no charge.

## Pricing & Fees

### Room Rates
Room rates vary by season and availability:
- Standard Room: $200-350 per night
- Deluxe Room: $350-500 per night
- Suite: $550-900 per night

Rates are subject to change and do not include taxes and fees.

### Resort Fees
A resort fee of $35 per night per night applies and includes WiFi, fitness center access, and pool access.

### Parking Fees
$15 per night

### Pet Fees
$50 per stay (non-refundable)

### Extra Guest Charges
Additional guests beyond standard occupancy: $25 per person per night (children under 12 stay free)

## Location & Transportation

### Address & Directions
987 State Street, Chicago, IL 60605

### Airport Transportation
Airport shuttle service is not provided. Taxi and rideshare services are readily available.

### Public Transportation
The hotel is conveniently located near public transportation options. Please contact the front desk for detailed directions and schedules.

### Nearby Attractions
Spacious suites in the Loop district Our concierge can provide recommendations and assistance with booking local tours and attractions.

## Services

### Room Service
Room service is not available. However, many delivery options are available in the area.

### Housekeeping
Daily housekeeping service is provided. Additional cleaning services can be requested at the front desk.

### Laundry Services
Laundry services can be arranged through the front desk with local providers.

### Concierge Services
Front desk staff are happy to provide local recommendations and assistance.

### Wake-up Calls
Automated wake-up calls can be arranged through your in-room phone or by contacting the front desk.

## Policies

### Smoking Policy
Lakeview Horizon Suites is a non-smoking property. Smoking is permitted in designated outdoor areas only. A cleaning fee of $250 applies to any smoking in guest rooms.

### Age Requirements
Guests must be at least 18 years of age to check in.

### ID Requirements
A valid government-issued photo ID and credit card are required at check-in.

### Damage Policy
Guests are responsible for any damage to hotel property. Charges for damages will be applied to the credit card on file.

### Quiet Hours
Quiet hours are observed from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. We ask all guests to be respectful of others during these hours.

## WiFi & Technology

### WiFi Availability
Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms and public areas.

### Network Access
Network name and password are provided at check-in and are also available in your guest room.

### Smart TV
All rooms feature smart TVs with access to premium channels and streaming capabilities.

### Charging Ports
Rooms are equipped with USB charging ports and standard electrical outlets.

## Special Requests

### Cribs & Rollaway Beds
Cribs are available at no charge (subject to availability). Rollaway beds are available for $25 per night.

### Connecting Rooms
Connecting rooms are available and can be requested at the time of booking (subject to availability).

### Floor Preferences
High floor and low floor preferences can be requested but cannot be guaranteed. We will do our best to accommodate your preference.

### Hypoallergenic Rooms
Hypoallergenic rooms with special cleaning protocols are available upon request. Please notify us at the time of booking.

## Additional Information

For any questions or special requests, please contact us at:
- Phone: +1-312-555-0006
- Email: chicagosuites@anycompany.com

We look forward to welcoming you to Lakeview Horizon Suites!

**Phone:** +1-414-555-0184
**Email:** milwaukee2@anycompany.com

## Check-in & Check-out

### Check-in Time
Standard check-in time is 3:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to availability and may be requested at the time of booking or by contacting the hotel directly.

### Check-out Time
Standard check-out time is 11:00 AM. Late check-out until 2:00 PM may be available for an additional fee of $50, subject to availability.

### Express Check-out
Express check-out is available. Guests can review and approve their bill the night before departure and simply drop off their room keys at the front desk or in the express check-out box.

## Reservations & Cancellations

### Making a Reservation
Reservations can be made through:
- Our website: www.anycompany.com
- Phone: +1-414-555-0184
- Email: milwaukee2@anycompany.com
- Mobile app: AnyCompany Hotels

### Cancellation Policy
Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours prior to arrival to avoid a one-night room charge. Cancellations for group bookings (10+ rooms) require 72 hours notice.

### Modification Policy
Reservations can be modified up to 24 hours before arrival at no charge. Changes to dates are subject to availability and rate differences may apply.

### Deposit Requirements
A valid credit card is required at the time of booking. A deposit equal to one night's room rate plus tax will be charged at booking for reservations made within 7 days of arrival.

### Payment Methods
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and Diners Club. Cash and debit cards are also accepted.

## Room Information

### Room Types Available
- **Standard Room:** Comfortable accommodations with essential amenities ($350-500 per night)
- **Deluxe Room:** Enhanced space and upgraded amenities ($500-750 per night)
- **Suite:** Spacious suite with separate living area ($800-1500 per night)

### Bed Configurations
- King bed
- Two Queen beds
- Accessible rooms with King bed

### Maximum Occupancy
- Standard/Deluxe Rooms: Up to 4 guests
- Suites: Up to 6 guests

### In-Room Amenities
All rooms include:
- Complimentary high-speed WiFi
- Flat-screen TV with premium channels
- Coffee maker with complimentary coffee and tea
- Mini-refrigerator
- In-room safe
- Iron and ironing board
- Hair dryer
- Complimentary toiletries
- Climate control

### Accessibility Features
Accessible rooms are available featuring:
- Roll-in showers or accessible tubs
- Grab bars
- Lowered fixtures
- Visual alert systems
- Accessible door hardware

## Hotel Amenities

- Outdoor Swimming Pool
- Full-Service Spa
- Complimentary High-Speed Wifi
- On-Site Restaurant
- Lounge Bar
- Direct Beach Access

### Pool
Our outdoor pool is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Pool towels are provided.

### Fitness Center
Fitness center facilities are not available at this property.

### Restaurant & Bar
Our on-site restaurant serves breakfast (6:30 AM - 10:30 AM), lunch (11:30 AM - 2:30 PM), and dinner (5:30 PM - 10:00 PM). The bar is open from 4:00 PM to midnight.

### Business Center
Business center facilities are not available at this property.

### Parking
Parking is available for $25 per night (self-parking). Self-parking is available in our parking facility.

### Pet Policy
Pets are welcome! We charge a non-refundable pet fee of $75 per stay. Maximum of 2 pets per room, with a weight limit of 50 lbs per pet. Service animals are always welcome at no charge.

## Pricing & Fees

### Room Rates
Room rates vary by season and availability:
- Standard Room: $350-500 per night
- Deluxe Room: $500-750 per night
- Suite: $800-1500 per night

Rates are subject to change and do not include taxes and fees.

### Resort Fees
A resort fee of $35 per night per night applies and includes WiFi, fitness center access, and pool access.

### Parking Fees
$25 per night (self-parking)

### Pet Fees
$75 per stay (non-refundable)

### Extra Guest Charges
Additional guests beyond standard occupancy: $25 per person per night (children under 12 stay free)

## Location & Transportation

### Address & Directions
1332 Wisconsin Avenue, Milwaukee, WI 53203

### Airport Transportation
Airport shuttle service is not provided. Taxi and rideshare services are readily available.

### Public Transportation
The hotel is conveniently located near public transportation options. Please contact the front desk for detailed directions and schedules.

### Nearby Attractions
Premium hotel featuring local charm Our concierge can provide recommendations and assistance with booking local tours and attractions.

## Services

### Room Service
Room service is not available. However, many delivery options are available in the area.

### Housekeeping
Daily housekeeping service is provided. Additional cleaning services can be requested at the front desk.

### Laundry Services
Laundry services can be arranged through the front desk with local providers.

### Concierge Services
Front desk staff are happy to provide local recommendations and assistance.

### Wake-up Calls
Automated wake-up calls can be arranged through your in-room phone or by contacting the front desk.

## Policies

### Smoking Policy
Lakeshore Inn is a non-smoking property. Smoking is permitted in designated outdoor areas only. A cleaning fee of $250 applies to any smoking in guest rooms.

### Age Requirements
Guests must be at least 18 years of age to check in.

### ID Requirements
A valid government-issued photo ID and credit card are required at check-in.

### Damage Policy
Guests are responsible for any damage to hotel property. Charges for damages will be applied to the credit card on file.

### Quiet Hours
Quiet hours are observed from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. We ask all guests to be respectful of others during these hours.

## WiFi & Technology

### WiFi Availability
Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms and public areas.

### Network Access
Network name and password are provided at check-in and are also available in your guest room.

### Smart TV
All rooms feature smart TVs with access to premium channels and streaming capabilities.

### Charging Ports
Rooms are equipped with USB charging ports and standard electrical outlets.

## Special Requests

### Cribs & Rollaway Beds
Cribs are available at no charge (subject to availability). Rollaway beds are available for $25 per night.

### Connecting Rooms
Connecting rooms are available and can be requested at the time of booking (subject to availability).

### Floor Preferences
High floor and low floor preferences can be requested but cannot be guaranteed. We will do our best to accommodate your preference.

### Hypoallergenic Rooms
Hypoallergenic rooms with special cleaning protocols are available upon request. Please notify us at the time of booking.

## Additional Information

For any questions or special requests, please contact us at:
- Phone: +1-414-555-0184
- Email: milwaukee2@anycompany.com

We look forward to welcoming you to Lakeshore Inn!

texts:
# Lakeview Horizon Suites

## Hotel Overview
Lakeview Horizon Suites is located in Chicago, IL, USA. Spacious suites in the Loop district

**Guest Rating:** 4.4/5.0
**Total Rooms:** 220

## Contact Information
**Address:** 987 State Street, Chicago, IL 60605
**Phone:** +1-312-555-0006
**Email:** chicagosuites@anycompany.com

## Check-in & Check-out

### Check-in Time
Standard check-in time is 3:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to availability and may be requested at the time of booking or by contacting the hotel directly.

### Check-out Time
Standard check-out time is 11:00 AM. Late check-out until 2:00 PM may be available for an additional fee of $50, subject to availability.

### Express Check-out
Express check-out is available. Guests can review and approve their bill the night before departure and simply drop off their room keys at the front desk or in the express check-out box.

## Reservations & Cancellations

### Making a Reservation
Reservations can be made through:
- Our website: www.anycompany.com
- Phone: +1-312-555-0006
- Email: chicagosuites@anycompany.com
- Mobile app: AnyCompany Hotels

### Cancellation Policy
Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours prior to arrival to avoid a one-night room charge. Cancellations for group bookings (10+ rooms) require 72 hours notice.

### Modification Policy
Reservations can be modified up to 24 hours before arrival at no charge. Changes to dates are subject to availability and rate differences may apply.

### Deposit Requirements
A valid credit card is required at the time of booking. A deposit equal to one night's room rate plus tax will be charged at booking for reservations made within 7 days of arrival.

### Payment Methods
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and Diners Club. Cash and debit cards are also accepted.

## Room Information

### Room Types Available
- **Standard Room:** Comfortable accommodations with essential amenities ($200-350 per night)
- **Deluxe Room:** Enhanced space and upgraded amenities ($350-500 per night)
- **Suite:** Spacious suite with separate living area ($550-900 per night)

### Bed Configurations
- King bed
- Two Queen beds
- Accessible rooms with King bed

### Maximum Occupancy
- Standard/Deluxe Rooms: Up to 4 guests
- Suites: Up to 6 guests

### In-Room Amenities
All rooms include:
- Complimentary high-speed WiFi
- Flat-screen TV with premium channels
- Coffee maker with complimentary coffee and tea
- Mini-refrigerator
- In-room safe
- Iron and ironing board

Rooms are equipped with USB charging ports and standard electrical outlets.

Hypoallergenic rooms with special cleaning protocols are available upon request. Please notify us at the time of booking.

- Phone: +1-312-555-0006
- Email: chicagosuites@anycompany.com

- Complimentary High-Speed Wifi

Our 24-hour fitness center is equipped with cardio machines, free weights, and strength training equipment.

### Restaurant & Bar
Our on-site restaurant serves breakfast (6:30 AM - 10:30 AM), lunch (11:30 AM - 2:30 PM), and dinner (5:30 PM - 10:00 PM). The bar is open from 4:00 PM to midnight.

Business center facilities are not available at this property.

Parking is available for $15 per night. Self-parking is available in our parking facility.

Pets are welcome! We charge a non-refundable pet fee of $50 per stay. Maximum of 2 pets per room, with a weight limit of 50 lbs per pet. Service animals are always welcome at no charge.

### Room Rates
Room rates vary by season and availability:
- Standard Room: $200-350 per night
- Deluxe Room: $350-500 per night
- Suite: $550-900 per night

$50 per stay (non-refundable)

987 State Street, Chicago, IL 60605

Airport shuttle service is not provided. Taxi and rideshare services are readily available.

The hotel is conveniently located near public transportation options. Please contact the front desk for detailed directions and schedules.

### Nearby Attractions
Spacious suites in the Loop district Our concierge can provide recommendations and assistance with booking local tours and attractions.

Room service is not available. However, many delivery options are available in the area.

Front desk staff are happy to provide local recommendations and assistance.

### Wake-up Calls
Automated wake-up calls can be arranged through your in-room phone or by contacting the front desk.

Lakeview Horizon Suites is a non-smoking property. Smoking is permitted in designated outdoor areas only. A cleaning fee of $250 applies to any smoking in guest rooms.

A valid government-issued photo ID and credit card are required at check-in.

Guests are responsible for any damage to hotel property. Charges for damages will be applied to the credit card on file.

Quiet hours are observed from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. We ask all guests to be respectful of others during these hours.

Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms and public areas.

### Network Access
Network name and password are provided at check-in and are also available in your guest room.

All rooms feature smart TVs with access to premium channels and streaming capabilities.

Rooms are equipped with USB charging ports and standard electrical outlets.

Connecting rooms are available and can be requested at the time of booking (subject to availability).

High floor and low floor preferences can be requested but cannot be guaranteed. We will do our best to accommodate your preference.

Hypoallergenic rooms with special cleaning protocols are available upon request. Please notify us at the time of booking.

For any questions or special requests, please contact us at:
- Phone: +1-312-555-0006
- Email: chicagosuites@anycompany.com

# Lakeview Horizon Suites

## Hotel Overview
Lakeview Horizon Suites is located in Chicago, IL, USA. Spacious suites in the Loop district

**Guest Rating:** 4.4/5.0
**Total Rooms:** 220

## Contact Information
**Address:** 987 State Street, Chicago, IL 60605
**Phone:** +1-312-555-0006
**Email:** chicagosuites@anycompany.com

## Check-in & Check-out

### Check-in Time
Standard check-in time is 3:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to availability and may be requested at the time of booking or by contacting the hotel directly.

### Check-out Time
Standard check-out time is 11:00 AM. Late check-out until 2:00 PM may be available for an additional fee of $50, subject to availability.

### Express Check-out
Express check-out is available. Guests can review and approve their bill the night before departure and simply drop off their room keys at the front desk or in the express check-out box.

## Reservations & Cancellations

### Making a Reservation
Reservations can be made through:
- Our website: www.anycompany.com
- Phone: +1-312-555-0006
- Email: chicagosuites@anycompany.com
- Mobile app: AnyCompany Hotels

### Cancellation Policy
Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours prior to arrival to avoid a one-night room charge. Cancellations for group bookings (10+ rooms) require 72 hours notice.

### Modification Policy
Reservations can be modified up to 24 hours before arrival at no charge. Changes to dates are subject to availability and rate differences may apply.

### Deposit Requirements
A valid credit card is required at the time of booking. A deposit equal to one night's room rate plus tax will be charged at booking for reservations made within 7 days of arrival.

### Payment Methods
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and Diners Club. Cash and debit cards are also accepted.

## Room Information

### Room Types Available
- **Standard Room:** Comfortable accommodations with essential amenities ($200-350 per night)
- **Deluxe Room:** Enhanced space and upgraded amenities ($350-500 per night)
- **Suite:** Spacious suite with separate living area ($550-900 per night)

### Bed Configurations
- King bed
- Two Queen beds
- Accessible rooms with King bed

### Maximum Occupancy
- Standard/Deluxe Rooms: Up to 4 guests
- Suites: Up to 6 guests

### In-Room Amenities
All rooms include:
- Complimentary high-speed WiFi
- Flat-screen TV with premium channels
- Coffee maker with complimentary coffee and tea
- Mini-refrigerator
- In-room safe
- Iron and ironing board
- Hair dryer
- Complimentary toiletries
- Climate control

### Accessibility Features
Accessible rooms are available featuring:
- Roll-in showers or accessible tubs
- Grab bars
- Lowered fixtures
- Visual alert systems
- Accessible door hardware

## Hotel Amenities

- Outdoor Swimming Pool
- 24-Hour Fitness Center
- Complimentary High-Speed Wifi
- On-Site Restaurant
- Full-Service Spa

### Pool
Our outdoor pool is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Pool towels are provided.

### Fitness Center
Our 24-hour fitness center is equipped with cardio machines, free weights, and strength training equipment.

### Restaurant & Bar
Our on-site restaurant serves breakfast (6:30 AM - 10:30 AM), lunch (11:30 AM - 2:30 PM), and dinner (5:30 PM - 10:00 PM). The bar is open from 4:00 PM to midnight.

### Business Center
Business center facilities are not available at this property.

### Parking
Parking is available for $15 per night. Self-parking is available in our parking facility.

### Pet Policy
Pets are welcome! We charge a non-refundable pet fee of $50 per stay. Maximum of 2 pets per room, with a weight limit of 50 lbs per pet. Service animals are always welcome at no charge.

## Pricing & Fees

### Room Rates
Room rates vary by season and availability:
- Standard Room: $200-350 per night
- Deluxe Room: $350-500 per night
- Suite: $550-900 per night

Rates are subject to change and do not include taxes and fees.

### Resort Fees
A resort fee of $35 per night per night applies and includes WiFi, fitness center access, and pool access.

### Parking Fees
$15 per night

### Pet Fees
$50 per stay (non-refundable)

### Extra Guest Charges
Additional guests beyond standard occupancy: $25 per person per night (children under 12 stay free)

## Location & Transportation

### Address & Directions
987 State Street, Chicago, IL 60605

### Airport Transportation
Airport shuttle service is not provided. Taxi and rideshare services are readily available.

### Public Transportation
The hotel is conveniently located near public transportation options. Please contact the front desk for detailed directions and schedules.

### Nearby Attractions
Spacious suites in the Loop district Our concierge can provide recommendations and assistance with booking local tours and attractions.

## Services

### Room Service
Room service is not available. However, many delivery options are available in the area.

### Housekeeping
Daily housekeeping service is provided. Additional cleaning services can be requested at the front desk.

### Laundry Services
Laundry services can be arranged through the front desk with local providers.

### Concierge Services
Front desk staff are happy to provide local recommendations and assistance.

### Wake-up Calls
Automated wake-up calls can be arranged through your in-room phone or by contacting the front desk.

## Policies

### Smoking Policy
Lakeview Horizon Suites is a non-smoking property. Smoking is permitted in designated outdoor areas only. A cleaning fee of $250 applies to any smoking in guest rooms.

### Age Requirements
Guests must be at least 18 years of age to check in.

### ID Requirements
A valid government-issued photo ID and credit card are required at check-in.

### Damage Policy
Guests are responsible for any damage to hotel property. Charges for damages will be applied to the credit card on file.

### Quiet Hours
Quiet hours are observed from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. We ask all guests to be respectful of others during these hours.

## WiFi & Technology

### WiFi Availability
Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms and public areas.

### Network Access
Network name and password are provided at check-in and are also available in your guest room.

### Smart TV
All rooms feature smart TVs with access to premium channels and streaming capabilities.

### Charging Ports
Rooms are equipped with USB charging ports and standard electrical outlets.

## Special Requests

### Cribs & Rollaway Beds
Cribs are available at no charge (subject to availability). Rollaway beds are available for $25 per night.

### Connecting Rooms
Connecting rooms are available and can be requested at the time of booking (subject to availability).

### Floor Preferences
High floor and low floor preferences can be requested but cannot be guaranteed. We will do our best to accommodate your preference.

### Hypoallergenic Rooms
Hypoallergenic rooms with special cleaning protocols are available upon request. Please notify us at the time of booking.

## Additional Information

For any questions or special requests, please contact us at:
- Phone: +1-312-555-0006
- Email: chicagosuites@anycompany.com

We look forward to welcoming you to Lakeview Horizon Suites!

texts:
# Lakeview Horizon Suites

## Hotel Overview
Lakeview Horizon Suites is located in Chicago, IL, USA. Spacious suites in the Loop district

**Guest Rating:** 4.4/5.0
**Total Rooms:** 220

## Contact Information
**Address:** 987 State Street, Chicago, IL 60605
**Phone:** +1-312-555-0006
**Email:** chicagosuites@anycompany.com

## Check-in & Check-out

### Check-in Time
Standard check-in time is 3:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to availability and may be requested at the time of booking or by contacting the hotel directly.

### Check-out Time
Standard check-out time is 11:00 AM. Late check-out until 2:00 PM may be available for an additional fee of $50, subject to availability.

### Express Check-out
Express check-out is available. Guests can review and approve their bill the night before departure and simply drop off their room keys at the front desk or in the express check-out box.

## Reservations & Cancellations

### Making a Reservation
Reservations can be made through:
- Our website: www.anycompany.com
- Phone: +1-312-555-0006
- Email: chicagosuites@anycompany.com
- Mobile app: AnyCompany Hotels

### Cancellation Policy
Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours prior to arrival to avoid a one-night room charge. Cancellations for group bookings (10+ rooms) require 72 hours notice.

### Modification Policy
Reservations can be modified up to 24 hours before arrival at no charge. Changes to dates are subject to availability and rate differences may apply.

### Deposit Requirements
A valid credit card is required at the time of booking. A deposit equal to one night's room rate plus tax will be charged at booking for reservations made within 7 days of arrival.

### Payment Methods
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and Diners Club. Cash and debit cards are also accepted.

## Room Information

### Room Types Available
- **Standard Room:** Comfortable accommodations with essential amenities ($200-350 per night)
- **Deluxe Room:** Enhanced space and upgraded amenities ($350-500 per night)
- **Suite:** Spacious suite with separate living area ($550-900 per night)

### Bed Configurations
- King bed
- Two Queen beds
- Accessible rooms with King bed

### Maximum Occupancy
- Standard/Deluxe Rooms: Up to 4 guests
- Suites: Up to 6 guests

### In-Room Amenities
All rooms include:
- Complimentary high-speed WiFi
- Flat-screen TV with premium channels
- Coffee maker with complimentary coffee and tea
- Mini-refrigerator
- In-room safe
- Iron and ironing board
- Hair dryer
- Complimentary toiletries
- Climate control

### Accessibility Features
Accessible rooms are available featuring:
- Roll-in showers or accessible tubs
- Grab bars
- Lowered fixtures
- Visual alert systems
- Accessible door hardware

## Hotel Amenities

- Outdoor Swimming Pool
- 24-Hour Fitness Center
- Complimentary High-Speed Wifi
- On-Site Restaurant
- Full-Service Spa

### Pool
Our outdoor pool is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Pool towels are provided.

### Fitness Center
Our 24-hour fitness center is equipped with cardio machines, free weights, and strength training equipment.

### Restaurant & Bar
Our on-site restaurant serves breakfast (6:30 AM - 10:30 AM), lunch (11:30 AM - 2:30 PM), and dinner (5:30 PM - 10:00 PM). The bar is open from 4:00 PM to midnight.

### Business Center
Business center facilities are not available at this property.

### Parking
Parking is available for $15 per night. Self-parking is available in our parking facility.

### Pet Policy
Pets are welcome! We charge a non-refundable pet fee of $50 per stay. Maximum of 2 pets per room, with a weight limit of 50 lbs per pet. Service animals are always welcome at no charge.

## Pricing & Fees

### Room Rates
Room rates vary by season and availability:
- Standard Room: $200-350 per night
- Deluxe Room: $350-500 per night
- Suite: $550-900 per night

Rates are subject to change and do not include taxes and fees.

### Resort Fees
A resort fee of $35 per night per night applies and includes WiFi, fitness center access, and pool access.

### Parking Fees
$15 per night

### Pet Fees
$50 per stay (non-refundable)

### Extra Guest Charges
Additional guests beyond standard occupancy: $25 per person per night (children under 12 stay free)

## Location & Transportation

### Address & Directions
987 State Street, Chicago, IL 60605

### Airport Transportation
Airport shuttle service is not provided. Taxi and rideshare services are readily available.

### Public Transportation
The hotel is conveniently located near public transportation options. Please contact the front desk for detailed directions and schedules.

### Nearby Attractions
Spacious suites in the Loop district Our concierge can provide recommendations and assistance with booking local tours and attractions.

## Services

### Room Service
Room service is not available. However, many delivery options are available in the area.

### Housekeeping
Daily housekeeping service is provided. Additional cleaning services can be requested at the front desk.

### Laundry Services
Laundry services can be arranged through the front desk with local providers.

### Concierge Services
Front desk staff are happy to provide local recommendations and assistance.

### Wake-up Calls
Automated wake-up calls can be arranged through your in-room phone or by contacting the front desk.

## Policies

### Smoking Policy
Lakeview Horizon Suites is a non-smoking property. Smoking is permitted in designated outdoor areas only. A cleaning fee of $250 applies to any smoking in guest rooms.

### Age Requirements
Guests must be at least 18 years of age to check in.

### ID Requirements
A valid government-issued photo ID and credit card are required at check-in.

### Damage Policy
Guests are responsible for any damage to hotel property. Charges for damages will be applied to the credit card on file.

### Quiet Hours
Quiet hours are observed from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. We ask all guests to be respectful of others during these hours.

## WiFi & Technology

### WiFi Availability
Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms and public areas.

### Network Access
Network name and password are provided at check-in and are also available in your guest room.

### Smart TV
All rooms feature smart TVs with access to premium channels and streaming capabilities.

### Charging Ports
Rooms are equipped with USB charging ports and standard electrical outlets.

## Special Requests

### Cribs & Rollaway Beds
Cribs are available at no charge (subject to availability). Rollaway beds are available for $25 per night.

### Connecting Rooms
Connecting rooms are available and can be requested at the time of booking (subject to availability).

### Floor Preferences
High floor and low floor preferences can be requested but cannot be guaranteed. We will do our best to accommodate your preference.

### Hypoallergenic Rooms
Hypoallergenic rooms with special cleaning protocols are available upon request. Please notify us at the time of booking.

## Additional Information

For any questions or special requests, please contact us at:
- Phone: +1-312-555-0006
- Email: chicagosuites@anycompany.com

We look forward to welcoming you to Lakeview Horizon Suites!

texts:
# Lakeview Horizon Suites

## Hotel Overview
Lakeview Horizon Suites is located in Chicago, IL, USA. Spacious suites in the Loop district

**Guest Rating:** 4.4/5.0
**Total Rooms:** 220

## Contact Information
**Address:** 987 State Street, Chicago, IL 60605
**Phone:** +1-312-555-0006
**Email:** chicagosuites@anycompany.com

## Check-in & Check-out

### Check-in Time
Standard check-in time is 3:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to availability and may be requested at the time of booking or by contacting the hotel directly.

### Check-out Time
Standard check-out time is 11:00 AM. Late check-out until 2:00 PM may be available for an additional fee of $50, subject to availability.

### Express Check-out
Express check-out is available. Guests can review and approve their bill the night before departure and simply drop off their room keys at the front desk or in the express check-out box.

## Reservations & Cancellations

### Making a Reservation
Reservations can be made through:
- Our website: www.anycompany.com
- Phone: +1-312-555-0006
- Email: chicagosuites@anycompany.com
- Mobile app: AnyCompany Hotels

### Cancellation Policy
Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours prior to arrival to avoid a one-night room charge. Cancellations for group bookings (10+ rooms) require 72 hours notice.

### Modification Policy
Reservations can be modified up to 24 hours before arrival at no charge. Changes to dates are subject to availability and rate differences may apply.

### Deposit Requirements
A valid credit card is required at the time of booking. A deposit equal to one night's room rate plus tax will be charged at booking for reservations made within 7 days of arrival.

### Payment Methods
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and Diners Club. Cash and debit cards are also accepted.

## Room Information

### Room Types Available
- **Standard Room:** Comfortable accommodations with essential amenities ($200-350 per night)
- **Deluxe Room:** Enhanced space and upgraded amenities ($350-500 per night)
- **Suite:** Spacious suite with separate living area ($550-900 per night)

### Bed Configurations
- King bed
- Two Queen beds
- Accessible rooms with King bed

### Maximum Occupancy
- Standard/Deluxe Rooms: Up to 4 guests
- Suites: Up to 6 guests

### In-Room Amenities
All rooms include:
- Complimentary high-speed WiFi
- Flat-screen TV with premium channels
- Coffee maker with complimentary coffee and tea
- Mini-refrigerator
- In-room safe
- Iron and ironing board
- Hair dryer
- Complimentary toiletries
- Climate control

### Accessibility Features
Accessible rooms are available featuring:
- Roll-in showers or accessible tubs
- Grab bars
- Lowered fixtures
- Visual alert systems
- Accessible door hardware

## Hotel Amenities

- Outdoor Swimming Pool
- 24-Hour Fitness Center
- Complimentary High-Speed Wifi
- On-Site Restaurant
- Full-Service Spa

### Pool
Our outdoor pool is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Pool towels are provided.

### Fitness Center
Our 24-hour fitness center is equipped with cardio machines, free weights, and strength training equipment.

### Restaurant & Bar
Our on-site restaurant serves breakfast (6:30 AM - 10:30 AM), lunch (11:30 AM - 2:30 PM), and dinner (5:30 PM - 10:00 PM). The bar is open from 4:00 PM to midnight.

### Business Center
Business center facilities are not available at this property.

### Parking
Parking is available for $15 per night. Self-parking is available in our parking facility.

### Pet Policy
Pets are welcome! We charge a non-refundable pet fee of $50 per stay. Maximum of 2 pets per room, with a weight limit of 50 lbs per pet. Service animals are always welcome at no charge.

## Pricing & Fees

### Room Rates
Room rates vary by season and availability:
- Standard Room: $200-350 per night
- Deluxe Room: $350-500 per night
- Suite: $550-900 per night

Rates are subject to change and do not include taxes and fees.

### Resort Fees
A resort fee of $35 per night per night applies and includes WiFi, fitness center access, and pool access.

### Parking Fees
$15 per night

### Pet Fees
$50 per stay (non-refundable)

### Extra Guest Charges
Additional guests beyond standard occupancy: $25 per person per night (children under 12 stay free)

## Location & Transportation

### Address & Directions
987 State Street, Chicago, IL 60605

### Airport Transportation
Airport shuttle service is not provided. Taxi and rideshare services are readily available.

### Public Transportation
The hotel is conveniently located near public transportation options. Please contact the front desk for detailed directions and schedules.

### Nearby Attractions
Spacious suites in the Loop district Our concierge can provide recommendations and assistance with booking local tours and attractions.

## Services

### Room Service
Room service is not available. However, many delivery options are available in the area.

### Housekeeping
Daily housekeeping service is provided. Additional cleaning services can be requested at the front desk.

### Laundry Services
Laundry services can be arranged through the front desk with local providers.

### Concierge Services
Front desk staff are happy to provide local recommendations and assistance.

### Wake-up Calls
Automated wake-up calls can be arranged through your in-room phone or by contacting the front desk.

## Policies

### Smoking Policy
Lakeview Horizon Suites is a non-smoking property. Smoking is permitted in designated outdoor areas only. A cleaning fee of $250 applies to any smoking in guest rooms.

### Age Requirements
Guests must be at least 18 years of age to check in.

### ID Requirements
A valid government-issued photo ID and credit card are required at check-in.

### Damage Policy
Guests are responsible for any damage to hotel property. Charges for damages will be applied to the credit card on file.

### Quiet Hours
Quiet hours are observed from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. We ask all guests to be respectful of others during these hours.

## WiFi & Technology

### WiFi Availability
Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms and public areas.

### Network Access
Network name and password are provided at check-in and are also available in your guest room.

### Smart TV
All rooms feature smart TVs with access to premium channels and streaming capabilities.

### Charging Ports
Rooms are equipped with USB charging ports and standard electrical outlets.

## Special Requests

### Cribs & Rollaway Beds
Cribs are available at no charge (subject to availability). Rollaway beds are available for $25 per night.

### Connecting Rooms
Connecting rooms are available and can be requested at the time of booking (subject to availability).

### Floor Preferences
High floor and low floor preferences can be requested but cannot be guaranteed. We will do our best to accommodate your preference.

### Hypoallergenic Rooms
Hypoallergenic rooms with special cleaning protocols are available upon request. Please notify us at the time of booking.

## Additional Information

For any questions or special requests, please contact us at:
- Phone: +1-312-555-0006
- Email: chicagosuites@anycompany.com

We look forward to welcoming you to Lakeview Horizon Suites!
